exposure: adolescent and young adult (AYA) breast cancer history
cohort: The cohort included 1,189,980 deliveries from mothers, 474 of whom had a history of AYA breast cancer, identified from universal health data in Ontario, Canada.
finding: A history of AYA breast cancer was associated with an increased risk of planned and unplanned cesarean delivery, but not with other adverse pregnancy outcomes like preterm birth, small for gestational age, or preeclampsia.
mod_finding: AYA breast cancer was associated with increased risk of planned (aRR 1.27) and unplanned (aRR 1.41) cesarean delivery, with this risk persisting in singleton pregnancies but not in models stratified by fertility treatment.
